note: Small family-run RV park in a meadow backed by pine forest at the Modoc National Forest edge, about 2 mi off SR-139 near the south entrance to Lava Beds National Monument. Hot tub and kayak rentals; the nearest big grocery is in Klamath Falls. --Claude
summary: Operator site (moved to eaglesnestrvp.com; old domain parked), rates page, Hipcamp and Google read. $45 nightly (under the gate, no exception needed), weekly/monthly offered but nightly is the core; 20 pull-through 30x70 ft FHU sites, 30/50 A; showers, dump (fee), wifi; laundry cleared (operator lists none, Hipcamp 'No'); phone booking; military discount. Google 4.5 (82), RV Life $$. Keep. Not waterfront kept.
